meta.name: Track brand visibility in ChatGPT results with OpenAI and Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## AI Visibility Tracker for Brands in (ChatGPT)

### How it works

This workflow runs weekly to measure AI visibility for a set of queries stored in Google Sheets. It creates three sample runs for each query, asks ChatGPT, judges the generated answers, and parses the judge output. Once all samples are complete, it aggregates them into a visibility score and appends the results back to Google Sheets.

### Setup steps

- Configure the schedule trigger with the desired weekly run time and timezone.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and select the spreadsheet/range containing the query set in the read node.
- Configure the output Google Sheets node with the destination spreadsheet and sheet for appended visibility results.
- Add OpenAI API authentication to both HTTP Request nodes and verify the Chat Completions request bodies, model names, and prompts are correct.

### Customization

Adjust the fan-out code to change the number of samples per query, update the judging prompt or scoring logic to match your visibility criteria, and change the schedule frequency if weekly tracking is too infrequent.

## Load and queue samples

Starts the workflow on a weekly schedule, reads the query set from Google Sheets, expands each query into three sample runs, and controls batch execution through the sample loop.

## Ask and judge responses

Runs each sampled query against ChatGPT, sends the answer to a judging prompt, then parses the judge output and returns the enriched sample metadata back into the loop.

## Score and save results

After all samples have been processed, aggregates the per-query sample judgments into a 0-100 visibility score and appends the final results to Google Sheets.
